responsibility: This very large definition module is the central public interface for mc’s declaration and abstract-syntax subsystem. It defines the opaque node type and exports the constructors, predicates, scope and module lookup routines, type/declaration attachment helpers, comment attachment hooks, code-building operations, language-selection controls, and final out routine that together let the parser passes build, annotate, query, and finally emit the compiler’s cross-pass AST and symbol universe.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is decl’s exported contract: it publishes the opaque node type and the enormous constructor/query/output API used across passes, while the same-named .mod file contains the actual node variant definitions, scope/universe state, builtins setup, and output logic.
